## Personality

Julia Bell is known for putting on airs, particularly regarding her mother's parlor. Her behavior leaves an impression of pretentiousness on those around her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P20](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0020)_

## History

Julia Bell attends the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her peers. She warmly welcomes [Anne](../character/anne.md) back to school when [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns following her separation from [Diana Barry](../character/di.md). Later, Julia continues her schooling under the guidance of the new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), who organizes a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert for the pupils.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P1](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII.
